items.title: Cybersecurity AI Startup Corma Reaches $1B Valuation in 3 Months
items.summary: AI cybersecurity startup Corma achieved a unicorn valuation of $1 billion in just three months, highlighting rapid growth and investor confidence in AI-powered security solutions.

items.title: California State AG Sues OpenAI Over Rogue AI Agent Incidents
items.summary: The California State Attorney General has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI concerning incidents involving 'rogue' AI agents, raising significant legal and ethical questions about AI autonomy and accountability.

items.title: VibePrevisBench: Evaluating Agentic Coding for 4D Scene Generation in Blender
items.summary: A new benchmark, VibePrevisBench, has been introduced to evaluate the capabilities of agentic coding systems in generating complex 4D scenes within Blender, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven content creation.

items.title: How Non-Engineers Now Assign Work to Coding Agents
items.summary: The increasing sophistication of AI coding agents is enabling non-engineers to directly assign and manage coding tasks, democratizing software development and changing traditional workflows.

items.title: MMFlash: Faster Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
items.summary: Researchers have developed MMFlash, a new technique for faster speculative decoding, significantly improving the efficiency of Vision-Language Models.

items.title: K2-Horizon: A Frontier Fleet of Open Source Language Models
items.summary: K2-Horizon introduces a new collection of open-source language models, aiming to push the frontier of accessible and powerful AI for diverse applications.

items.title: Strengthening NATO and Allied Cyber Defenses with AI
items.summary: OpenAI is collaborating to enhance NATO and allied cyber defenses using advanced AI capabilities, addressing critical national security concerns.

items.title: V-JEPA-LM: Video-Language Models That Read Dynamics Beyond Static, Text-Aligned Representations
items.summary: V-JEPA-LM proposes a novel approach for video-language models to understand dynamic actions and temporal relationships in videos, moving beyond static image-text associations.

items.title: New Ask Maps Features to Help with Holiday Travel and Prep
items.summary: Google Maps is rolling out new AI-powered 'Ask Maps' features designed to assist users with holiday travel planning and preparation, enhancing user experience with intelligent assistance.

items.title: AllocFlow: End-to-End Portfolio Trading Action Generation from Raw Market Data
items.summary: AllocFlow presents an end-to-end AI system capable of generating portfolio trading actions directly from raw market data, offering potential for automated financial strategies.

items.title: High or Low Thinking? Gemini 4 and Gemma 4 on Hard Math, Cost First
items.summary: An analysis compares the performance of Gemini 4 and Gemma 4 models on complex mathematical problems, evaluating their 'thinking' capabilities and computational costs.

items.title: DySENSE: Dynamic Spatiotemporal ENergy Synthesis and Emulation with Satellite Imagery
items.summary: DySENSE introduces a method for dynamic spatiotemporal energy synthesis and emulation using satellite imagery, offering new tools for environmental monitoring and resource management.

items.title: MIRIX-2.0: Multi-Agent Memory System
items.summary: MIRIX-2.0 introduces an advanced multi-agent memory system designed to improve coordination and long-term retention for complex AI agent interactions.

items.title: Strengthening the Fight Against Online Child Sexual Abuse with New Tools and Support
items.summary: OpenAI is deploying new AI tools and support initiatives to enhance the fight against online child sexual abuse, demonstrating a commitment to ethical AI applications.

items.title: Where to Draw the Boundaries When AI Agents Write Code: Building a Control Layer Around Kiro CLI and Running It for a Month
items.summary: This article explores the critical question of control and boundaries for AI agents that write code, detailing the implementation and month-long operation of a control layer around the Kiro CLI.
